$comment: Ambient Director cards (docs/design.md, The living city): after 45-75 s of play with no active objective, the director stages one card within 150 m from sim primitives. Each card says when it may run (nearby feature, time, weather, threat, district), who is in it (robots by archetype, never a person as a target), what happens (beats, in order) and what the player gets (payoff). Cards with a bad robot never run in a protected area, where the director adds nothing above the baseline. Checked by checkDirectorCards in src/content/directorCards.ts.

provenance.review: Pending: a second agent session reads every line against the checklist in docs/ai-layer.md, then the user reviews a stratified 10% sample.

cards.title: Snatch in progress
cards.blurb: A bad Footman is lifting a good one's groceries.

payoff.note: Melt it during the snatch: +50% cash and +1 reputation.

cards.title: Oranges downhill
cards.blurb: A snatch spills a bag of oranges down the hill.

payoff.note: Melt the snatcher; the oranges keep rolling either way.

cards.title: Two-bag job
cards.blurb: Two bad Footmen work one shopper robot from both sides.

payoff.note: Two in the act; the second is posted to BotBounty.

cards.title: Courier heist
cards.blurb: A fake courier lifts a parcel from a good Trundle's lid.

payoff.note: Watch which Trundle reaches the door.

cards.title: The line cutter
cards.blurb: A bad Footman cuts the queue and leaves with someone else's bread.

cards.title: Update on the corner
cards.blurb: A good Footman's face light reads 'Updating 0%'.

payoff.note: Rust the pusher to 0.2 within 6 s and the update stops.

cards.title: Charging dock update
cards.blurb: A good Trundle plugs in; a bad Footman plugs in next to it.

cards.title: Two updates, one pusher
cards.blurb: The pusher finishes one robot and heads for the next.

payoff.note: The first one shows 'Update complete' for 60 s and is posted. Save the second.

cards.title: The convert
cards.blurb: A Trundle shows 'Update complete' and rolls the wrong way.

payoff.note: Posted to BotBounty for 60 s; subtlety 1.

cards.title: Poster swap
cards.blurb: A Footman smooths a Moat Labs ad over a bus-shelter poster.

cards.title: The billboard climber
cards.blurb: A bad Footman is pasting a 'comeback' teaser on a billboard.

cards.title: Pickup sniffer
cards.blurb: A Trundle has parked by the robotaxi pickup for a long time.

cards.title: Plate reader
cards.blurb: A thin scan beam passes over the parked cars, one by one.

cards.title: Bus-stop sniffer
cards.blurb: Phones at the bus stop keep glitching.

payoff.note: Bystanders at the stop: spray only the robot, and only when no one is in the stream's path.

cards.title: Door chimes
cards.blurb: 'Pairing... pairing...' from the row of parked cars.

cards.title: Hydrant blocker
cards.blurb: An empty robotaxi parks square across the hydrant.

payoff.note: Cone the hood, then spray. It is always empty.

cards.title: The loop
cards.blurb: An empty robotaxi passes the same corner for the third time.

cards.title: Your parking spot
cards.blurb: A robotaxi is parked in the spot you wanted.

payoff.note: A good robotaxi just pulls over and moves along when coned. No spray needed.

cards.title: Stuck in a puddle
cards.blurb: A Trundle is stuck in a puddle, wheels spinning.

payoff.note: A good robot: splash-rated, happy in the puddle. Push it free; never spray it.

cards.title: Puddle dodger
cards.blurb: One Footman steps around every puddle on the block.

payoff.note: Compare the two: the good one walks straight through.

cards.title: Awning hideout
cards.blurb: Robots shelter under an awning in the rain. One has no cape.

cards.title: The fog edge
cards.blurb: A Footman turns back at the edge of the fog bank.

payoff.note: Subtlety 4: worth more.

cards.title: Lost in the fog
cards.blurb: A Trundle loops the same corner in the fog.

payoff.note: A false tell: it still goes into the fog. Spraying it is a wrong target (-5 reputation, -$50).

cards.title: Sun crowd
cards.blurb: Robots crowd into the one sunny patch on a foggy evening.

payoff.note: Bad robots avoid fog; good ones just like the sun. Read before you spray.

cards.title: Low battery
cards.blurb: A Footman stands through a whole walk signal.

payoff.note: Watch its status light: 3%. A false tell.

cards.title: The robot
cards.blurb: A Footman stops at a bus stop and does the robot.

payoff.note: A false tell. Applause is free.

cards.title: The pigeon apology
cards.blurb: A Trundle apologises to a pigeon for some time.

payoff.note: Talking to nobody looks like a bad robot's loop line; it is just manners.

cards.title: Fresh off the dock
cards.blurb: A robot reads 100%. Is it the one that never charges?

payoff.note: Both read 100%. Only one just left the dock. Subtlety 4.

cards.title: Empty bag home
cards.blurb: A Footman with an empty bag walks away from the shops.

payoff.note: Two empty bags. One is going home; the other is going shopping.

cards.title: Who looked up?
cards.blurb: You scan; three robots glance over. One doesn't.

payoff.note: A ping makes bad robots wary, not obvious. Watch instead.

cards.title: Scenic route
cards.blurb: A good Meander circles the block. It is signalling every turn.

payoff.note: Rogue robotaxis skip signals. This one is just enthusiastic.

cards.title: The copycat
cards.blurb: Something stops when you stop.

payoff.note: Subtlety 5 pays double.

cards.title: The stairs
cards.blurb: Two Footmen reach the steps. One takes the ramp.

payoff.note: Footmen always take ramps. Subtlety 5.

cards.title: The tail
cards.blurb: A Footman follows another at two metres, turn for turn.

cards.title: The hum
cards.blurb: Four notes, again and again, somewhere in the crowd.

payoff.note: Watch isolates its audio.

cards.title: The lobby lurker
cards.blurb: A Footman waits outside a lobby. Nobody comes.

cards.title: Three steps
cards.blurb: A Footman walks three steps forward, three back.

cards.title: The door
cards.blurb: A Trundle rolls to a door and turns away on the last step.

payoff.note: Two Trundles, one door. Only one lid opens.

cards.title: Crew of three
cards.blurb: BotBounty posts one robot. Two more are nearby.

payoff.note: Melting one alerts the others: threat 1, maybe 2.

cards.title: Van drop
cards.blurb: A graphite van stops at the curb and two units step out.

payoff.note: Threat 2 delivery: vans bring units from HQ or a depot.

cards.title: Last-seen broadcast
cards.blurb: A seizing robot sends your position; two more look up.

payoff.note: Break line of sight: fog, traffic or a car wash.

cards.title: Car wash escape
cards.blurb: Threat on your tail and a car wash ahead.

beats.text: A car wash drops one level of threat.

payoff.note: Your sensor signature is washed off.

cards.title: Went viral
cards.blurb: A melt in front of a crowd: phones out.

payoff.note: Five or more people within 25 m: +1/4 VC star. Mind the stream: people get wet.

cards.title: Apology tour
cards.blurb: A good robot you rusted is limping to the kiosk.

payoff.note: Walk it to the kiosk to win back reputation.

cards.title: Restored from backup
cards.blurb: A converted helper reboots at the kiosk.

payoff.note: 'Restored from backup. Some memories may be lost.'

cards.title: A thank-you
cards.blurb: The robot whose groceries you saved catches up with you.

cards.title: Motor trouble
cards.blurb: A Footman's motor gives out on a flat block, bags and all.

payoff.note: Starts a SoMa delivery shift (wave 2).

cards.title: Market queue
cards.blurb: At the Ferry Building stalls, one Footman skips the line.

cards.title: Demo unit
cards.blurb: A Footman in a conference lanyard is 'demoing' on a stranger's groceries.

cards.title: The drawbridge
cards.blurb: A Trundle paces by the drawbridge and never crosses.

cards.title: Depot hydrant
cards.blurb: An empty robotaxi blocks the depot hydrant at the bridge touchdown.

cards.title: Laps of the Green
cards.blurb: A Footman runs perfect laps of the lawn, carrying nothing.

cards.title: Bench snoop
cards.blurb: Someone's reading the tuning bench screen over your shoulder.

cards.title: Hilltop
cards.blurb: A Footman on Rincon Hill faces the bridge, perfectly still.

cards.title: QR flyers
cards.blurb: A Footman holds out QR flyers to sightseers on Jefferson St.

payoff.note: Tourists all around: aim with care.

cards.title: Turntable squatter
cards.blurb: At the head of the cable car queue, a Footman never boards.

cards.title: Night loop
cards.blurb: A Trundle on Columbus Ave loops the block after midnight.

cards.title: Just bumping this
cards.blurb: A VC associate on a scooter pulls up beside you, phone already ringing.

payoff.note: Press Decline six times, or keep moving faster than 2 m/s.

cards.title: After you
cards.blurb: A Footman holds a door open for a whole queue of robots, and then for you.

payoff.note: Ordinary good behaviour: the baseline every bad robot imitates.

cards.title: Parcel mix-up
cards.blurb: Two good Trundles swap parcels at a corner and apologise at length.

payoff.note: Lots of apologising is a good sign.
